title.rendered: He Is Singing Over You — Morning Devotional

excerpt.rendered: God is not disappointed in you — He is singing over you with joy and delight. A Saturday devotional on Zephaniah 3:17 and the extravagant love of a Father who celebrates you.

content.rendered:
Gospelbuzz Morning Devotional — Saturday, April 11, 2026

Scripture for Today — Zephaniah 3:17

“The Lord your God is with you, the Mighty Warrior who saves. He will take great delight in you; in his love he will no longer rebuke you, but will rejoice over you with singing.”
— Zephaniah 3:17 (NIV)

Today’s Devotional Message

Stop and let this land for a moment.

God is singing over you. Not correcting you. Not listing your failures. Not holding up your shortcomings. Singing. Over you. With joy.

Zephaniah 3:17 is one of the most startling verses in the Old Testament — startling because we spend so much of our religious life assuming that God’s primary posture toward us is disappointment or judgment, and this verse says something so different it takes a moment to absorb. He takes great delight in you. He rejoices over you with singing.

The Hebrew word translated “rejoice” here is giyl — it means to spin around with joy, to leap, to be overtaken by delight. It is the most exuberant word for joy available in the language. And the word for “singing” is rinnah — a ringing, triumphant shout of praise. This is not God humming a quiet lullaby. This is God erupting in celebration over the sight of you.

Why? Not because you are perfect. Not because you have earned it. Because you are His. Because He made you. Because He chose you. The love of God is not based on your performance — it is based on His nature. He cannot stop loving you. It would require Him to stop being God.

Going into the weekend, carry this truth. Not the voice of accusation or the weight of what you should have done differently this week. The voice of a Father singing. The delight of a God who is not merely tolerating your existence but celebrating it.

Let Him sing over you today. Let it get through.

Prayer for Today

Father, I find this hard to believe — that You would sing over me. I am more accustomed to expecting Your disappointment than Your delight. But Your Word says this, and Your Word is true. Today I choose to receive it. Sing over me. Let Your joy reach the parts of my heart that have felt only shame or distance. I am Yours — and that is enough reason for You to rejoice. Thank You. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

Daily Declaration

“God takes great delight in me. He rejoices over me with singing. I am not a burden to Him — I am a joy. His love is not based on my performance but on His character. Today I rest in the delight of my Father. He is singing.”

📖 Further Reading — Related Scriptures

  • Romans 8:38–39 — Nothing can separate us from the love of God. It is not fragile — it is indestructible.
  • 1 John 3:1 — “See what great love the Father has lavished on us, that we should be called children of God!” — The word “lavished” suggests extravagance, not moderation.
  • Psalm 149:4 — “For the Lord takes delight in his people.” — A parallel confirmation: God’s posture toward His people is delight.
  • Luke 15:20 — The father running to meet the returning prodigal — the clearest picture of God’s joy at our return. He was watching for you.
  • Ephesians 1:4–5 — “In love he predestined us for adoption.” — You were chosen. In love. Before you could do anything to earn or lose it.
